reason: A Telegram Bot API bridge that lets allowlisted private chats interact with DSH agent sessions, with per-chat context, queuing, and command handling.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot API 将允许名单中的私聊消息接入 DSH 智能体会话，并提供按聊天维持上下文、排队处理和会话管理功能。
summaries.en: Connects allowlisted Telegram private chats to DSH agent sessions with per-chat context, queued message handling, and session management.

capabilities: Receives Telegram private-chat messages through the Bot API
Maps chats to persistent in-memory agent sessions
Sends user messages to DSH agents and returns final assistant responses
Queues messages per chat and supports session reset commands
